description: This file declares functions related to device parameter values management in an AMX adapter, including get and set operations, and includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetParameterValues_GetValues

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_SetParameterValues_Validate

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_SetParameterValues_SetValues
methods.description: Sets parameter values on the device.
